def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # simple pursuit: turn toward enemy and go forward
    bx = enemy.x - me.x
    by = enemy.y - me.y
    # angle of enemy in world frame
    target_heading = degrees(atan2(by, bx))
    # difference from current heading
    diff = (target_heading - me.heading + 180) % 360 - 180
    # proportional turn
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, diff / 45.0))  # full turn at 45 deg error
    # forward throttle
    fwd = 0.8 if abs(diff) < 30 else 0.4
    left = fwd + turn
    right = fwd - turn
    # clamp
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
    return (left, right)

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    # keep spinner at max rpm
    return spin("front", 3500)

def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # vector to enemy
    dx = enemy.x - me.x
    dy = enemy.y - me.y
    dist = hypot(dx, dy)

    # desired heading toward enemy
    target = degrees(atan2(dy, dx))
    diff = (target - me.heading + 180) % 360 - 180

    # turn proportionally
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, diff / 25.0))

    # distance to arena centre
    r = hypot(me.x, me.y)
    # if too close to wall, add a component steering away
    wall_turn = 0.0
    if r > 5.5:
        # bearing from centre to robot
        centre_bearing = degrees(atan2(me.y, me.x))
        # we want to turn toward centre
        diff_c = (centre_bearing - me.heading + 180) % 360 - 180
        wall_turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, -diff_c / 30.0))

    # forward throttle: be aggressive but keep a safe bite distance (~1.5 m)
    if dist > 2.0:
        fwd = 0.9
    elif dist > 1.5:
        fwd = 0.6
    else:
        fwd = 0.2   # back off a little when too close

    left = fwd + turn + wall_turn
    right = fwd - turn - wall_turn
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
    return (left, right)

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    # keep front vertical spinner at max rpm
    return spin("front", 3000)

def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # vector to enemy
    dx = enemy.x - me.x
    dy = enemy.y - me.y
    dist = hypot(dx, dy)

    # desired heading toward enemy
    target = degrees(atan2(dy, dx))
    diff = (target - me.heading + 180) % 360 - 180

    # proportional turn, limited
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, diff / 20.0))

    # wall avoidance: steer toward centre when near the bubble
    r = hypot(me.x, me.y)
    wall_turn = 0.0
    if r > 5.5:
        centre_bearing = degrees(atan2(me.y, me.x))
        diff_c = (centre_bearing - me.heading + 180) % 360 - 180
        # turn toward centre
        wall_turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, -diff_c / 25.0))

    elif dist > 1.0:

    right = fwd - turn - wall_turn
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
